source: design/trevor-reading-order-research.md (Arctic Shift archive of r/arknights, wiki, 7 community guides; 2026-09-29)

essential.name: Darknights Memoir
essential.why: the single most important one; basically the real chapter 7

essential.name: Babel
essential.why: tells the story of the Doctor's past; a must-read before Episode 14

essential.name: A Walk in the Dust
essential.why: context for basically everything after Episode 8

essential.name: Lone Trail
essential.why: ties into the main story; Dorothy's Vision first

essential.name: Vigilo
essential.why: major for learning about the pre-amnesia Doctor

essential.name: See You Soon
essential.why: the ending of the Victoria war; with Ending a Grand Overture and When Elegies Are Ashes

essential.name: Path of Life
essential.why: connects to the main story after Episode 14

essential.name: Operational Intelligence
essential.why: only the stories 'Anonymous One's War' and 'Destroyer', before Episode 7

rules.name: Babel
rules.rule: right after Episode 13, before Episode 14 (4 commenters: any time after Vigilo or Episode 8)

rules.name: Lone Trail
rules.rule: after Episode 14 (older advice: after Episode 12; read Episodes 7 and 8 and Dorothy's Vision first)

rules.name: What the Firelight Casts
rules.rule: after Episode 11, before Episode 12 (at least after Episode 9)

rules.name: Operational Intelligence
rules.rule: 'Anonymous One's War' and 'Destroyer' after Episodes 3 to 5, before Episode 7

rules.name: See You Soon
rules.rule: after Episode 14, before Episode 15, then Ending a Grand Overture

rules.name: Lingering Echoes
rules.rule: before Zwillingstürme im Herbst (with Hortus de Escapismo)

chronological.why: Babel, Darknights Memoir and A Walk in the Dust come first in the timeline and spoil the Doctor's amnesia; many stories have no fixed date

patterns: main story first with must-read side stories
one storyline at a time (the game's Movements view since Sept 2025)
